nodes.title: Roshan Kumar Gupta
nodes.description: Research Engineer and Systems Architect. Founder of Earthos Lab, Author of 'The AGI Question', creator of FieldChain, Writrieve, TARS, Navisense, and ModelVM. Specializes in hardware-sympathetic software, GPU computing (Vulkan/CUDA/C++), and cognitive architectures.

nodes.title: Earthos Lab & Ventures
nodes.description: Deep-tech venture ecosystem founded by Roshan Kumar Gupta. Houses Earthos Lab (startup), Project Earthos (platform), Synapse Arch (cognitive substrate), and The AGI Question (monograph).

nodes.title: Architectural Projects
nodes.description: Flagship engineering systems: FieldChain (166.86 GiB/s GPU storage), Writrieve (System-1 context engine), TARS (exoplanet recovery), Navisense (ISRO GNSS-denied navigation), and ModelVM (virtual memory for LLMs).

nodes.title: Core Technical Skills
nodes.description: Hardware-sympathetic stack: Low-level GPU systems (Vulkan, CUDA, PTX, C++), Physics-Constrained ML, Deterministic Runtimes, and Distributed Web Architecture.

nodes.title: Education & Identity
nodes.description: Academic foundation and research leadership. B.Tech Computer Science at Chandigarh University, Department Student Representative (Oct 2025 – Sep 2026), and independent systems research.

nodes.title: Experience & Milestones
nodes.description: Research grants, enterprise engineering, hackathon championships, and upstream open-source contributions across Apache, CNCF, and Linux Foundation.

nodes.title: Earthos Lab (Startup)
nodes.description: The deep-tech research venture and startup founded by Roshan Kumar Gupta. Focuses on sovereign cognitive substrates, neuromorphic memory architectures, and hardware-sympathetic synthetic intelligence.

nodes.title: Project Earthos (Platform)
nodes.description: Production digital platform and interactive reader workspace deployed at earthos.shop. Built with Next.js 16, Supabase PostgreSQL, real-time edge telemetry, nearest-node multi-warehouse logistics, and sovereign reader sessions.

nodes.title: Synapse Arch (Cognitive Substrate)
nodes.description: 12-layer cognitive architecture and hardware-sympathetic execution substrate. Formalizes Memory Paging, Somatic Marker hypothesis, and Representation Darwinism with semi-permeable cognitive membranes (0.01 < κ < 0.20).

nodes.title: The AGI Question (Monograph)
nodes.description: Foundational 14-chapter monograph authored by Roshan Kumar Gupta: 'The AGI Question: What Does It Take to Become a Mind?'. Critiques disembodied next-token prediction, explores Antonio Damasio's neurobiology, and charts synthetic consciousness.

nodes.title: Ch 1: The Stateless Mind
nodes.description: Critique of next-token prediction without temporal continuity. Why statistical linguistic mirrors lack cognitive understanding.

nodes.title: Ch 2: The Traveler Who Forgets
nodes.description: The amnesia of stateless inference passes. Investigates why continuous inner monologue and memory consolidation are necessary for a mind.

nodes.title: Ch 3: The Map That Can't See Itself
nodes.description: Metacognitive recursive loops. Why an agent must model its own observation and reasoning process, not merely the external world.

nodes.title: Ch 4: The Belief Engine
nodes.description: Epistemic grounding vs conversational sycophancy. Formalizes Bayesian belief updating against empirical reality.

nodes.title: Ch 5: The Drawer That Jams
nodes.description: Associative memory retrieval bottlenecks. Analyzes vector collision degradation, memory paging, and interference in high-dimensional latent spaces.

nodes.title: Ch 6: Before You Act
nodes.description: Pre-motor counterfactual simulation engines. How a cognitive agent evaluates branching action trajectories before committing physical energy.

nodes.title: Ch 7: The Budget of a Mind
nodes.description: Homeostatic regulation and metabolic resource limits. Why vulnerability, energy budgets, and mortality are foundational to intelligence.

nodes.title: Ch 8: What the Stage Manager Does
nodes.description: Attentional arbitration and executive control networks. How the mind directs focus across multi-stream sensory inputs.

nodes.title: Ch 9: Minds Within Minds
nodes.description: Hierarchical multi-agent internal sub-processes. Modeling competing cognitive drives and internal consensus formation.

nodes.title: Ch 10: Interior Weather
nodes.description: Antonio Damasio's Somatic Marker hypothesis and the Paradox of Elliot. Why emotion and visceral gut-checks are indispensable to rational choice.

nodes.title: Ch 11: The Examined Mind
nodes.description: Autonomous error-monitoring circuits and reflective equilibrium. Detecting and repairing internal logical and sensory contradictions.

nodes.title: Ch 12: The Memory That Holds
nodes.description: Synaptic structural memory consolidation and sleep-phase replay. How acute working memory stabilizes into enduring world knowledge.

nodes.title: Ch 13: The Friction That Keeps Us Honest
nodes.description: Physical embodiment resistance and the semi-permeable cognitive membrane (0.01 < κ < 0.20). Surviving environmental noise without structural collapse.

nodes.title: Ch 14: Towards the Horizon
nodes.description: The synthetic consciousness roadmap. Formalizing substrate-independent minds, sovereign cognitive architectures, and artificial life.

nodes.title: Antonio Damasio: Somatic Markers
nodes.description: Visceral bias signals generated by the ventromedial prefrontal cortex (vmPFC). Prunes infinite combinatorial search spaces into computationally tractable decisions.

nodes.title: The Paradox of Elliot (vmPFC)
nodes.description: Patient Elliot exhibited superior IQ, intact grammar, and perfect logic, yet was paralyzed in real-world decisions due to lack of emotional somatic markers. Proof that reason requires visceral emotion.

nodes.title: Semi-Permeable Cognitive Membrane
nodes.description: Mathematical cognitive boundary (permeability 0.01 < κ < 0.20). Balances structural memory retention against environmental noise and reward exploitation.

nodes.title: Representation Darwinism
nodes.description: Survival law for internal world models: representations survive gradient optimization only if they actively support homeostatic balance against entropy.

nodes.title: Homeostatic Error Budgets
nodes.description: Substrate-independent homeostatic error budgets over compute, memory, latency, and predictive uncertainty. Gives synthetic systems existential stakes.

nodes.title: Metacognitive Self-Modeling
nodes.description: Recursive internal observers that model the agent's own reasoning process and error confidence rather than passively predicting tokens.

nodes.title: Episodic Memory Paging
nodes.description: Multi-tier memory architecture decoupling working context from permanent episodic stores via semantic indexing and decay weighting.

nodes.title: Pre-Motor Counterfactual Simulation
nodes.description: Simulation engine modeling alternative action trajectories before physical actuation, pruning high-risk paths using somatic marker heuristics.

nodes.title: Epistemic Grounding
nodes.description: Truth-anchored verification distinguishing reality from persuasive hallucinations and user sycophancy.

nodes.title: Executive Attentional Control
nodes.description: Dynamic arbitration mechanism managing sensory bandwidth and multi-modal attention focus.

nodes.title: Hierarchical Multi-Agency
nodes.description: Sub-agent specialization and internal dialogue modeled as a society of cooperating processes.

nodes.title: Reflective Error Monitoring
nodes.description: Internal supervisory loops monitoring contradiction, divergence, and uncertainty across inference passes.

nodes.title: Synaptic Structural Consolidation
nodes.description: Long-term structural memory replay stabilizing transient observations into resilient network priors.

nodes.title: Synthetic Consciousness Roadmap
nodes.description: Substrate-independent framework integrating homeostasis, somatic valuation, and self-referential modeling.
